name: 51281-longprefix-8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B, bf16, unquantized. Already in the local HF cache (~16 GB).
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1; one in-process vLLM engine (guidellm's vllm_python backend, no HTTP server).
architecture: dense decoder-only transformer (Qwen3ForCausalLM): 36 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads of head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 151936, native context 40960, bfloat16.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, bounded at 4000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup 10% and cooldown 10% so the four shared prefixes are cache-resident before the measured window.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text: four shared 30000-token prefixes plus a fresh 512-token suffix per request, 32 output tokens, single turn, greedy, streaming. prefix_buckets is prefix_count 4, prefix_tokens 30000, bucket_weight 100; prompt and output lengths are pinned min == max.
purpose: A document-grounded assistant giving short streamed answers over four large shared document prefixes, 64 concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Pinned to what `dtype: auto` resolves to for this checkpoint, so it cannot drift.
dtype: bfloat16

# Covers the workload's worst case, 30000 + 512 + 32 = 30544, under the model's own 40960.
max-model-len: 32768

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9

# Load-bearing: the workload shares four 30000-token prefixes across every request.
enable-prefix-caching: true
